lines.text: Breath tastes of copper
Street lamps dim as if abashed
A tremor hums beneath my skin
Night tilts and will not right itself
I watch the sky bruise purple and split
A lattice of burning veins unspools
Each strand descends like hunting wire
Seeking pulse, seeking me
Windows frost from the inside out
Neighbors stand silent, heads tilted back
Eyes rinsed of color
Waiting for a promise that nobody spoke
Heartbeat slows as
Tendrils of descending divinity
Spiral through cloud and bone
Siphoning the spark behind our eyes
No plea, no sin, no memory
Survives the harvest
Only the hush of arteries unthreading
No blade can sever what isn't truly flesh
No faith can bargain with the engine of demise
We stand as brittle lanterns in the gale
Our marrow siphoned upward into shrinking skies
Life strains, then breaks, beneath the grip of godless surge
Blood and starlight rise in threads to feed a mouth unseen
Where once the world was loud with birth
Now stillness carves its throne
Tendrils tighten and
History suffocates as
Tendrils of descending divinity
Clamp the horizon shut
Dragging dawn beneath their wings of bone
We stand, small and lit like matches
Snuffed one by one
Smoke rising only to be stolen
Steel splits like damp paper
Oceans slump, peeled back to seabed dust
Mountains shed their crowns in sparks
All fed upward into that starving halo
